Billing FAQ
When will I be charged?
You are charged immediately on subscribing, then on the same date every month (or every year on a yearly plan). Your 30-day free trial gives you Starter-level access — subscribe anytime to unlock the full plan.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Cancelling stops renewal at the end of the current billing period. You keep access until then.
Is payment secure?
All payments are processed by Razorpay (PCI DSS Level 1 certified). FinBooks never stores your card details.
